text:
anya: Quick sync 10: we're doing an analyst pre-webinar tomorrow at 8:30am PT. It's a short 20-min walkthrough + Q&A. Can folks confirm presenters and who will handle on/off the record?

jess: I can present the product highlights + FAQ. leah — are you comfortable taking the question queue?

leah: Yep, Ill triage live Qs and escalate technical asks to eng. I'll also flag anything that should be background-only.

marco: Legal note: one analyst (TechPulse) asked for an NDA before the pre-brief. That's unusual for analysts. @sam-legal can you advise?

sam-legal: Looping in. We need the analyst name/firm and a copy of the NDA request. If it's a standard analyst non-disclosure for embargoed benchmarks, we can fast-track a one-way NDA within 4 hours.

press-bot: [automated] webinar pre-brief scheduled: 2026-04-08T08:30:00-07:00. Calendar invites sent to external analyst list. Reminder +30m.

anya: Okay — jess, can you share the short slide deck (5 slides) and the one-pager? We'll keep numbers high-level until legal clears NDA flow.

jess: Deck uploaded: https://docs.example.com/launch/webinar-prebrief-deck (internal). One-pager in same folder.

marco: I'm attaching the NDA request email in the doc comments. TechPulse wants pre-brief under NDA because they'll cite internal latency numbers in the preview.

leah: If legal doesn't approve NDA in time, we should proceed but mark the specific benchmark comparisons as background-only and offer a follow-up embargoed deep-dive.

sam-legal: Read the request. It's a customized NDA asking for reciprocal confidentiality. We can't accept reciprocity for analyst pre-briefs. Offer: one-way CDA limited to embargoed benchmark numbers + 30-day expiry. I can prepare and send within 90 minutes if approved.

anya: Yes please proceed with the one-way CDA. Send to marco and jess for review, then to TechPulse. We need sign-back before 8:20am PT.

jess: Noted. Also: who will confirm quote attribution policy live? I want to avoid "on background" confusion.

leah: I'll make a clear welcome slide that states: "On the record unless stated otherwise; background statements will be explicitly labeled." Will remind everyone at the start.

press-bot: [automated reminder] assets checklist: deck, one-pager, FAQ, embargo note. Missing: signed CDA (if required).

marco: Small ask: product needs to vet any benchmark language in the deck. Theyre on a 2-hr turnaround but only during business hours. Flagging for urgency.

jess: I'll pull the benchmark slide and replace with descriptive language like "industry-leading latency" until product signs off on numbers.

sam-legal: CDA drafted and attached in the doc. Please review and leave comments. If approved, I'll send to TechPulse now.

anya: Thanks. Assignments: sam-legal -> send CDA, jess -> edit deck to removable-number mode, leah -> host/run Q&A tagging on/off record, marco -> liaison to TechPulse. I'll chair the pre-brief.

leah: Small ops note: can we run the call on the product's account (more permissive recording settings)? Also set meeting to disallow recording unless all parties consent.

anya: Agreed. Disable auto-record. We will ask for consent before recording any portion.

marco: TechPulse replied: will sign a one-way CDA. Ask: can we provide a short CSV of wall-clock p99s? Product asks for full review first.

jess: If product can't review the CSV in time, we can offer anonymized percentile ranges instead. Keep options ready.

press-bot: [automated] external invites updated with "no recording" note.

anya: Great work. We should be ready by 8:15am PT for final check. I'll post a final go/no-go 30m before. :white_check_mark:
